description:
The terminal key shortcuts row contains its overscroll while staying scrollable. Key shortcuts are turned on. "The row" is '[role="group"][aria-label="Terminal key shortcuts"]'. The viewport is 393x851.
1. Navigate to /new and open the Terminal workspace tool: phones keep workspace tools in the overflow menu, so click the visible button with aria-label exactly "More options", then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose text starts with "Terminal".
2. The row should be visible, and its computed overscroll-behavior-x must be "contain".
3. The row's scrollWidth - clientWidth should become greater than 0 (eval with expect true).
4. Eval: set the row's scrollLeft to its scrollWidth. Its scrollLeft should become greater than 0.
5. Click the button with aria-label exactly "Close active terminal".
